newsitem.title: USA: United HealthCare Corp Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: United HealthCare Corp Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Excluding the non-operating merger costs associated with the acquisition of HealthWise of America Inc. of $14.9 million or $0.05 per common share and the provision for future losses on two multi-year contracts of $45 million or $0.15 per common share, net earnings for the year ended December 31, 1996 would have been $392,217 or $1.96 per common share.

Excluding fourth quarter 1995 restructuring charges of $153.8 million ($96.9 million after tax, or $0.54 per common share) associated with the MetraHealth acquisition, net earnings for the three and twelve month periods ended December 31, 1995 would have been $109.9 million and $382.9 million, or $0.57 and $2.12 per common share, respectively.
